description: Get the FULL TEXT of a section of the Virgin Islands Code (V.I.C., US Virgin Islands statutes, 2026 edition) by citation, e.g. "14 V.I.C. § 922" (first and second degree murder) or "11A V.I.C. § 2-201" (UCC statute of frauds). Accepts "14 V.I.C. § 922", "14 VIC 922", "V.I. Code Ann. tit. 14, § 922" or "Title 14, Section 922". Returns the statutory text, the heading, and the "History:" amendment line. Source: USVI Public Records, Virgin Islands Code 2026 edition. Keyless.

citation.description: Citation as "<title> V.I.C. § <section>", e.g. "14 V.I.C. § 922" or "11A V.I.C. § 2-201".

name: vi_statute
